visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy dark hair is positioned on the reddish-brown track of a modern baseball stadium. She is wearing a distinctive red and white patterned haori-style jacket over a white top and shorts. She begins a rhythmic, high-energy jogging motion while smiling broadly at the camera. In the background, baseball players in blue uniforms are seen practicing on the green turf under bright stadium lights. (2) She raises both fists in a cheering gesture, her facial expression conveying intense joy and enthusiasm. Yellow-bordered captions appear at the bottom center. She then waves her hand in a greeting motion. The camera remains static, capturing her from a medium full-shot perspective as she performs synchronized steps. (3) The woman initiates a choreographed dance sequence involving hip rotations and punchy arm movements. She points towards the camera and then claps her hands above her head. A blue banner with the text 'Hey Hey supporters' appears as a persistent overlay. Her movements are fluid and energetic, maintaining a high level of physical engagement throughout the phase. (4) She moves closer to the lens, transitioning into a medium shot. She continues the dance with circular arm motions and rhythmic pointing gestures. More yellow captions appear at the bottom, reflecting a lyrical structure. The background details of the stadium seating and the scoreboard are visible but softly blurred. (5) She concludes the performance by forming a heart shape with her hands near her chest while winking at the camera. She then leans in for a extreme close-up, smiling with her mouth open and arms spread wide, before the screen cuts to black with a final text overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-frequency synthesized riser that leads into a punchy, high-tempo electronic pop beat. The music is dominated by a heavy, driving kick drum and bright synth melodies. The female vocalist provides a sharp 'Hey!' shout, establishing a high-energy, celebratory atmosphere right from the onset. (2) A rhythmic Mandarin rap begins, delivered by a female voice with high emotional arousal and bright pitch. The vocal delivery is fast and crisp, perfectly synchronized with the 128 BPM electronic backing track. Occasional bright synth stingers and 'shout' accents are layered over the main rap to enhance the rhythmic drive. (3) The rhythmic pattern continues with a consistent 4/4 electronic drum beat. The female voice maintains its energetic, positive valence, shifting through dynamic intonations. There is zero background noise, indicating a professionally mastered studio track designed for promotional use. Each lyrical phrase is punctuated by percussive synth stabs. (4) As the video nears its conclusion, the music ducks slightly, allowing the female speaker to transition from a rhythmic rap to a natural, friendly speaking voice. She delivers a final invitation in a cheerful tone. The track concludes with a short synthesized 'pop' sound as the audio cuts out entirely.
